name: Chenezale do Ragarl
original_name: チェネザリ・ド・ラガール
source:
Chenezale do Ragarl is a powerful mage living in the magic kingdom of Zeth. He is the father of one of the Four Lords, [url=/c98186]Nagi su Ragarl[/url]. Originally a noble man, he went crazy from his rivalry with Masou Souzou, [url=/c52701]Masou Shizuka[/url]'s father, and his unrequited love for her mother. He's the man Shizuka wants to kill the most out of vengeance over her father's death.

He's a deplorable man with no sense of morality and that has long since been lost to insanity, yet he still remains a very powerful and talented mage. As the father of one of the Four Lords of Zeth, he held a tremendous political power prior to an incident with his daughter. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Chenezale_do_Ragarl]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
